description:
Configure the web server settings for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test'.

1. Set the Directory Index priority so that 'promo.html' is the default file served when visiting the site root. You must keep 'index.php' in the list as a fallback (it should just be lower priority than promo.html).
2. Disable Directory Listing (Index Options) so that visiting a directory without an index file (like '/assets/') returns a 403 Forbidden error instead of a list of files.

The files 'promo.html' and 'index.php' already exist in the public_html directory. Use Virtualmin's 'Website Options' or manually edit the Apache directives to achieve this.
